description: UI/UX Core Enhancements: Add visible dark mode toggle button in navigation, remove purple gradients and replace with Palayan City brand colors (professional blue/green/neutral), replace pill-shaped buttons with standard government-style buttons, add sticky header with scroll shadow, enhance mobile menu, add hover states to all interactive elements, add scroll progress bar, add scroll-to-top button, add floating emergency contact button, add loading animations for page transitions, add password visibility toggle on all password fields, add copy-to-clipboard buttons for report IDs and coordinates
steps: 1. In src/components/layout/CitizenNav.jsx, add a dark mode toggle button. Import useTheme from context/ThemeContext. Call toggleTheme on click. Use Moon/Sun icon from lucide-react. Position in top right of nav bar. Style as icon button matching existing nav style

2. In src/index.css, search for all purple color references. Found: lines 2812 (pressure-icon purple #8b5cf6), 2814 (uv-icon purple #a855f7). Replace with neutral blues/grays or greens to match government palette. Update --accent-orange to a professional government blue if needed (currently orange #f97316 is acceptable for government alerts, but verify user preference). Document color changes

3. Audit all button components for pill-shaped border-radius. In src/index.css, find buttons with border-radius: 20px or higher (lines 2092, etc.). Reduce to border-radius: 8px or 10px for standard government style. Check src/components/ui/button.jsx and ensure border-radius is professional, not pill-shaped

4. Create src/components/layout/StickyHeader.jsx: component that detects scroll position with useEffect + window.scrollY. When scrollY > 50, add box-shadow. Style as sticky top-0 z-50. Initially render children (logo, nav items) without shadow, transition shadow on scroll

5. In HomeScreen.jsx or App.jsx, if there's a header section, wrap it in StickyHeader component. If no dedicated header exists, add a subtle top bar with CLIMA logo + dark mode toggle that becomes sticky
6. In CitizenNav mobile menu (if using hamburger), verify animations are smooth. Add framer-motion AnimatePresence for menu open/close. Ensure menu is keyboard accessible (focus trap, Esc to close)
7. Create src/hooks/useScrollProgress.js: hook that returns scroll percentage (0-100) based on document.documentElement.scrollTop vs scrollHeight

8. Create src/components/ui/ScrollProgressBar.jsx: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 bar with height 3px, background gradient from transparent to --accent-orange, width based on scroll percentage. Use useScrollProgress hook
9. In App.jsx, render <ScrollProgressBar /> as a sibling to the main content (inside app-shell div, above screens layer)

10. Create src/components/ui/ScrollToTopButton.jsx: fixed bottom-right button (bottom: 80px to avoid overlapping nav, right: 20px) with ArrowUp icon. Show only when scrollY > 300. On click, smooth scroll to top: window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }). Style as circular button with shadow and --accent-orange background
11. In App.jsx, render <ScrollToTopButton /> inside app-shell (z-index above content but below modals)

12. Create src/components/ui/FloatingContactButton.jsx: fixed bottom-right button (bottom: 140px, right: 20px) with Phone icon. On click, open tel: link or show emergency contact modal. Style as circular button with red/orange background, subtle pulse animation
13. In App.jsx, render <FloatingContactButton /> (or in HomeScreen/EmergencyScreen where appropriate)

14. Audit all interactive elements: buttons, links, cards. In src/index.css, add :hover and :focus-visible pseudo-classes with transform: translateY(-1px) or scale(1.02), transition: all 0.2s. Ensure all clickable elements have visible hover state. Check .desktop-nav-btn (line 1862 already has hover), .desktop-wind-card (should add hover), report cards, advisory cards, etc.

15. In App.jsx screenVariants motion config (lines 385-390), verify smooth transitions. Already using framer-motion AnimatePresence. Confirm initial/animate/exit states are smooth. Add loading spinner or skeleton during screen transitions if needed

16. In src/screens/ProfileScreen.jsx, find password input fields (lines 461-528). Add a toggle button (Eye/EyeOff icon from lucide-react) next to password input. On click, toggle input type between 'password' and 'text'. Repeat for ChangePasswordScreen, AdminLogin, ForgotPasswordScreen

17. In src/screens/AdminDashboard.jsx, when displaying report details (line 3065), show report ID with a copy-to-clipboard button. Create src/components/ui/CopyButton.jsx: button with Copy icon, on click copy text to clipboard (navigator.clipboard.writeText), show brief 'Copied!' tooltip. Apply to report IDs, coordinates (lat, lng)
18. In MapScreen or MapPopupContent, add CopyButton next to coordinates display
19. Run 'npm run build' and test all new UI elements in browser
acceptance_criteria: Dark mode toggle button visible in navigation, clicking it switches theme and persists to localStorage
No purple gradients or purple accent colors remain (except in heatmaps/charts if data-driven)
All buttons have border-radius <= 10px, no pill-shaped buttons
Header gains shadow when scrolling down, loses shadow at top of page
Scroll progress bar at top of viewport fills from 0% to 100% as user scrolls
Scroll-to-top button appears after scrolling down 300px, clicking it smoothly scrolls to top
Floating emergency contact button visible on all citizen screens, clickable
Hovering over any button, card, or link shows visual feedback (scale, shadow, or translation)
Password fields have eye icon toggle to reveal/hide password
Clicking copy button next to report ID or coordinates copies value to clipboard and shows 'Copied!' feedback
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit code 0
Locate dark mode toggle button in nav, click it and verify theme switches from light to dark (or vice versa), reload page and confirm theme persists
Search src/index.css for color values containing 'purple' or '#8b5cf6' or '#a855f7' and confirm replaced or removed
Inspect all buttons visually and measure border-radius in DevTools, confirm none exceed 10px
Scroll down the page and observe header shadow appears
Watch the top of viewport for thin progress bar that fills as you scroll
Scroll down past 300px and confirm scroll-to-top button fades in, click it and confirm smooth scroll to top
Verify floating contact button visible in bottom-right, click and confirm it triggers emergency contact action
Hover over all buttons, cards, links and confirm visual hover state (shadow, scale, or movement)
Find password input in Profile or Admin Login, click eye icon and confirm password becomes visible, click again and confirm it hides
In admin report details, click copy button next to report ID and confirm value is in clipboard (paste into notepad), verify 'Copied!' message appears briefly
